''' Related NPCs: ''' | Giants |} KINDLY or higher faction is required with Coldain for all Thurgadin armor quests. Set Totals ''(1 bracer)'': == Reward == {{Gear Set |Rowyl's Circlet of Nature |Rowyl's Chestguard of Nature |Rowyl's Vambraces of Nature |Rowyl's Bracer of Nature |Rowyl's Gauntlets of Nature |Rowyl's Greaves of Nature |Rowyl's Boots of Nature }} == Checklist == Turn-ins to [[Cobi Frostbeard]] in [[Thurgadin]].{{CheckboxList}} *[[Rowyl's Circlet of Nature]] :*[[Eroded Leather Cap]] :*3x [[Crushed Onyx Sapphire]] *[[Rowyl's Chestguard of Nature]] :*[[Eroded Leather Tunic]] :*3x [[Black Marble]] *[[Rowyl's Vambraces of Nature]] :*[[Eroded Leather Sleeves]] :*3x [[Jaundice Gem]] *[[Rowyl's Bracer of Nature]] :*[[Eroded Leather Bracelet]] :*3x [[Crushed Opal]] *[[Rowyl's Gauntlets of Nature]] :*[[Eroded Leather Gloves]] :*3x [[Crushed Lava Ruby]] *[[Rowyl's Greaves of Nature]] :*[[Eroded Leather Leggings]] :*3x [[Chipped Onyx Sapphire]] *[[Rowyl's Boots of Nature]] :*[[Eroded Leather Boots]] :*3x [[Crushed Flame Emerald]] {{End}} == Walkthrough == This quest begins with Cobi Frostbeard in Thurgadin. He's found in Frostbeard's Furs and Leather: After zoning in, cross both bridges, turn left towards the bank, then (at the bank) hang a right. He'll be in the second shop on the right. You say, 'Hail, Cobi Frostbeard' : Cobi Frostbeard says 'Greetings to you. I seek one who calls himself a druid. What do you call yourself, manling?' You say, 'I call myself a druid' : Cobi Frostbeard says 'Good. I had hoped you were one. As nature's guardian, you fight the never-ending struggle against those who seek to defile it. It is an admirable quality and I wish to aid you. I will provide you with a cap, a tunic, sleeves, bracers, gloves, leggings and boots.' '''After turn-in:''' Cobi Frostbeard smiles warmly as he hands you your reward. 'You have done well, _____.'
* Your faction standing with [[Coldain]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[Dain Frostreaver IV]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[Kromzek]] got worse. * Your faction standing with [[Kromrif]] got worse.
{{YouGainExperience}} == Circlet == You say, 'What cap?' : Cobi Frostbeard says, 'Those who are wise as we are know that protection of the head is the most important. I may be able to forge you something most interesting if you were to bring me three pieces of crushed onyx sapphire and an eroded leather cap. [[Crushed Onyx Sapphire]]s are dropped in various Velious zones while [[Eroded Leather Cap]]s drop from the higher level giants in Kael Drakkel. == Tunic == You say, 'What tunic?' : Cobi Frostbeard says, 'If you find an eroded leather tunic and three pieces of black marble bring them to me and I shall attempt to create an enchanted tunic that will serve you well.' [[Black Marble]]s are dropped in various Velious zones while [[Eroded Leather Tunic]] drops from the higher level giants in Kael Drakkel. == Sleeves == You say, 'What sleeves?' : Cobi Frostbeard says 'Three jaundice gems and a set of eroded leather sleeves might be an interesting combination. The powers of the gems may be harvested to imbue the sleeves.' [[Jaundice Gem|Jaundice Gems]] are dropped in various Velious zones while [[Eroded Leather Sleeves]] drops from the higher level giants in Kael Drakkel. == Bracers == You say, 'What bracers?' : Cobi Frostbeard says 'Bracers are quite easy to imbue. Simply find three crushed opals and an eroded leather bracer and I will complete the ritual to enchant them.' [[Crushed Opal]]s are dropped in various Velious zones while [[Eroded Leather Bracelet]]s drop from the higher level giants in Kael Drakkel. == Gloves == You say, 'What gloves?' : Cobi Frostbeard says 'Strong protection for one's hands is important. I may be able to craft you a set of powerful leather gloves if you find a set of eroded leather gloves and three crushed lava rubies.' [[Crushed Lava Ruby]]s are dropped in various Velious zones while [[Eroded Leather Gloves]] drop from the higher level giants in Kael Drakkel. == Leggings == You say, 'What leggings?' : Cobi Frostbeard says, 'Leggings are a bit trickier to imbue. Three chipped onyx sapphires will allow me to channel the correct energies into a pair of eroded leather leggings. However, those chipped onyx sapphires are somewhat rare. Return to me if you find such things in your journeys.' [[Chipped Onyx Sapphire]]s are dropped in various Velious zones while [[Eroded Leather Leggings]] drop from the higher level giants in Kael Drakkel. == Boots == You say, 'What boots?' : Cobi Frostbeard says 'Simply bring me a set of three crushed flame emeralds and a pair of eroded leather boots and I will imbue them. I bid you good luck in finding such things.' [[Crushed Flame Emerald]]s are dropped in various Velious zones while [[Eroded Leather Boots]] drop from the higher level giants in Kael Drakkel.
